subject: Keystore rotation playback & CI change approval evidence
messages:
From: LedgerSec Audit Team <auditor@ledgersec.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinBank Security <finbank-sec@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:15:00Z
Subject: Request: keystore rotation playback + CI approval trail for SOC2 evidence

Hi Jonas,

We're preparing the SOC2 intake for FinBank and need a compact evidence package showing how you rotate keystores tied to release changes. Specifically we need:

- A playback (chronological snapshot) of a single keystore rotation event with: HSM export logs (redacted), keystore snapshot hash, and the CI pipeline run IDs that triggered the change.
- The merge/approval audit for the PR that introduced the change (who approved, approval delegation, and any bypasses).
- CI role/agent identity used to perform the release and the timestamped approval step.

Can you provide a playback artifact and a short narrative (2-3 bullets) describing: canary rollout behavior, rollback/abort condition, and where the rotation records are persisted for future audits?

Audience: FinBank assessor.
Timeline: prefer by EOD Friday (2026-08-26) if possible.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
LedgerSec Audit Team
---
[LedgerSec prefers redacted HSM exports; please flag any secrets before sending]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: LedgerSec Audit Team <auditor@ledgersec.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, FinBank Security <finbank-sec@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T13:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: keystore rotation playback + CI approval trail for SOC2 evidence

Hi Asha,

Thanks for the clear checklist — we can produce a "playback" bundle and short narrative. Quick clarifying questions so we tailor the package:

- Do you need a full HSM export or a signed HSM operation log + hash? We prefer to share signed operation logs (redacted) rather than key material.
- For the CI traces, do you want the raw build logs (we'll redact env vars) or the CI provenance JSON (structured, includes step-level actor ids)?

Planned deliverables (we'll assemble an archive):
- keystore-rotation-playback-<timestamp>.zip (signed operation log, snapshot hash, rotation manifest)
- ci-run-logs-<id>.json (provenance extract, redacted envs)
- merge-approval-audit-<date>.csv (approver list + timestamp + approval method)
- short narrative (2-3 bullets) and drive links to PR and pipeline run.

I'll route the collection to Irene (security lead) to pull HSM logs and to Marissa on the release side for the CI artifacts. Expect a first tranche tomorrow.

Best,
Jonas
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
From: LedgerSec Audit Team <auditor@ledgersec.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinBank Security <finbank-sec@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: keystore rotation playback + CI approval trail for SOC2 evidence

Jonas,

Signed operation logs + snapshot hash is fine (no raw key material). For CI, the structured provenance JSON is preferred. Also please include:

- Evidence that merge approvals are enforced (branch protection + required reviewers) and any documented delegation (if emergency bypass used, include the exception ticket).
- The canonical storage location of rotation records (we need to verify retention policy).

If possible, include one example of a rollback-triggered re-rotation (a short note + timestamp) even if the rollback ultimately did not proceed.

Thanks,
Asha
LedgerSec
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: LedgerSec Audit Team <auditor@ledgersec.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, FinBank Security <finbank-sec@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T10:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: keystore rotation playback + CI approval trail for SOC2 evidence

Hi Asha — attaching the playback tranche and a short narrative. Summary up front:

- What youre getting: signed HSM operation log (redacted), snapshot hash (sha256), CI provenance JSON with step-level actor ids, and a CSV of merge approvals. See attachments and Drive link below.
- Canary + rollback: rotations use a canary window (5% of traffic for 30m). If canary health metrics degrade >5% we trigger an automatic abort and issue a re-rotation under a rollback ticket. One recent abort (2026-07-02T21:06Z) is flagged in the manifest — we include the ticket id.
- Storage & retention: rotation manifests and signed logs are stored in our immutable artifact bucket (s3://redwood-audit/keystore-rotations/) with 7-year retention. Access is via KMS-wrapped keys; HSM operation logs are archived in the HSM vendor portal.

Deliverables attached/in links:
- keystore-rotation-playback-20260822.zip (attachment) — includes: rotation-manifest.json (redacted), signed-hsm-ops.log (redacted), snapshot.sha256
- ci-run-logs-5478.json (attachment) — provenance extract for pipeline run 5478 (redacted env vars).
- merge-approval-audit-20260822.csv (attachment) — PR id, approver, timestamp, approval type (UI / delegated).

Drive & tickets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AabcKeystorePlayback  |  JIRA: SEC-4472  |  Rollback ticket: OPS-1129

Notes on enforcement:
- Branch protection: require PR review from two approvers for main releases.
- Emergency delegation: documented in our on-call runbook; emergency bypasss are executed via a documented escalation process with a postmortem and automatic rotation enforced after the change.

Attachments: keystore-rotation-playback-20260822.zip (tarred playback), ci-run-logs-5478.json, merge-approval-audit-20260822.csv

Let me know if you need additional redaction or a separate HSM vendor statement.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: LedgerSec Audit Team <auditor@ledgersec.com>, FinBank Security <finbank-sec@finbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: keystore rotation playback + CI approval trail for SOC2 evidence

Asha / FinBank team —

We've packaged the playback evidence and shared it to the Drive link above. Quick pointers for the assessor:

1) How to validate the playback:
   - Verify snapshot.sha256 matches the archive manifest.
   - Check signed-hsm-ops.log signatures using the HSM vendor cert bundled in the archive.
2) CI provenance:
   - ci-run-logs-5478.json includes the pipeline actor (agent-redwood-release) and the step-level hashes. We have redacted sensitive env values and kept step outcomes and timestamps intact.
3) Merge approvals:
   - merge-approval-audit-20260822.csv shows PR-1829 with two approvers and a documented delegation for one emergency override (OPS-1129).

Next steps:
- Asha: please confirm if the redaction level is acceptable for FinBank or if you need a vendor-signed HSM statement.
- FinBank: if you want an in-person walkthrough of the playback we'll schedule 30m with our security engineering team.

Attachments (referenced in Drive): keystore-rotation-playback-20260822.zip, ci-run-logs-5478.json, merge-approval-audit-20260822.csv

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Release Platform
Redwood Inference
